content: अगुरु {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Not heavy, light. .²2 (In prosody) Short. .²3 Having no teacher. .²4 One different from a teacher. .{@-रु@} {%n.%} ({%m.%} also) [न गुरुर्यस्मात्] .²1 The fragrant aloe wood and tree; Aquiluria Agallocha. .²2 That which yields Bdellium, Amyris Agallocha. .²3 The Śiśu tree (शिंशपा).
